title: vx lock --check --format json
description: The lock audit: exit 0 when upToDate, else 1 with each drift in problems.

audited.description: projects with a vx.config, each audited

notAudited.description: projects with tasks and no vx.config: nothing to freeze, never audited

code.description: Stable; branch on it, as schemas/error.json's: VX_E_LOCK for drift `vx lock` fixes (a missing lock is one), VX_E_CONFIG for a config that does not load or holds a secret, and a graph rule's own (VX_E_CYCLE, VX_E_DEPENDS_ON, VX_E_OUTPUT_OVERLAP, …)

message.description: the problem as the plain audit prints it on stderr; may change
